newsitem.title: UK: UK Japan stocks rally as bargain-hunters move in.
newsitem.headline: UK Japan stocks rally as bargain-hunters move in.

text.p: Japanese shares traded here were sharply higher as buyers moved in to pick up cheaper stock, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 rose 11.96 points to 1,544.21 by 1354 GMT.
"A lot of the blue chips we've seen sold off on currency worries over the last few days, we've seen them bought right back up," said a dealer.
"It's busy today, there's quite a bit of bargain hunting going on," said another.
Honda rose 60 yen to 3,370. Canon rose 45 yen to 2,745 yen.
